lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: I really like your new swimsuit. It looks great on you.
: Thank you so much :)
: Rin's is much better, though. It fits her a lot more.
: Well, with a chest as large as yours, you can't really expect everything to fit perfectly.
: I...meant her personality. Hahahah
: Mine is just striped and...I don't really think something like that says a lot about who I am as a person.
: Maybe you should get one with...books all over it or something?
: Yes. Because that is a swimsuit I am sure exists :P
: Hey, I don't know. I just don't want you talking about other people when you're the one I'm complimenting.
: That's very sweet of you, Sensei :)
: I'm glad you think I'm cute.
: You're not so bad yourself :)))
: Is that code for “Come over so we can pleasure each other?”
: It is...
: Not :)
: I'm still with Rin.
: That's fine. I'm sure she'd be happy to watch.
: But I wouldn't be happy to show her :P
: I'll be thinking of you, though :)
: In a sexual way or a normal way?
: In an “I wish you were here” way.
: You can imagine that means whatever you want :)
: It looks like you two were having fun. Wish I could have been there as well.
: We had a lot of fun!
: I used to go to the beach a lot when I was younger, but Rin was never really able to until she was a [teenager].
: We're making up for lost time now, I suppose :)
: When you put it like that, I feel like I'd just be getting in the way.
: I didn't mean it like that at all!
: We love you :) So we obviously want you to be here as well.
: It would be ten times more fun if we could all have fun together.
: Oh God. That looks a lot more embarrassing when it's written down. I'm sorry, hahahah.
: It's fine. I'm glad you two are having a good time.
: Feel free to send me more pictures. Especially in the event of any wardrobe malfunctions.
: Sorry, Sensei. I have to go. Rin's top just got lost in the ocean.
: Futaba...
: Kidding :)
: I miss you, though.
: Let's...do something soon :)
: Sounds good to me.
: Enjoy the ocean or whatever.
: Enjoy whatever you're doing right now.
: How were you able to wear those swimsuits in the middle of winter?
: It was...very difficult for both of us. Hahahaha.
: The cold doesn't bother me all too much, but...it's a different story when you're wearing a swimsuit.
: We wanted to enjoy the trip the best we could, though. So...yeah :)
: You're lucky you got to stay clothed the whole weekend!
: Am I really, though?
: I was about to say yes but then I realized you were being a pervert again :)
: Atta girl.
: I think you should still be happy, though :P Wouldn't IT get smaller in the cold?
: Not when it's hard.
: Really? I didn't know they worked that way :O
: I would have been happy to show you had you actually invited me wherever you two went.
: Yes, and I'm sure that Rin would have been very happy to see that :P
: I can't tell if you're being sarcastic or not, but I think we both know that's probably true.
: Hahahahaha
: For you, maybe. She'd probably feel very strange if I were involved. She's no Nodoka.
: Guess there's only one way to find out...
: Oh, look. My phone is about to die. I guess we'll never find out after all.
: Goodnight, Sensei. I'll talk to you later :)
